name: QUBOLib benchmark corpus
description: QUBOLib benchmark corpus — v0.2.4-data+4 QUBOLib is a curated corpus of binary quadratic optimization benchmarks with models, reference solutions, submitted solutions, and source provenance. This dataset contains 6263 instances across 5 collections. It preserves the exact qubolib.tar.gz distributed through the GitHub data release, not a software source archive. File identity and schema Compressed size: 102890681 bytes. SHA-256: 276eb06a66cec325cd3ec895cded7ba28f848aeb3998f4944466acbb33bcd001. Julia artifact tree SHA-1: 90da567266bc93ffb76cc0435691409557d500fc. Archive members: archive.h5 and index.db. Build: Julia 1.10.11, QUBOLib commit 8735aa035a082401a01b5cb2540bd1ebaf00c675. Data release target: QUBOLib commit 6fb487e1982857253afd7b20fc30868452b4d001. Inventory audited: 2026-09-28. index.db is the SQLite catalog of collections, instances, submissions, and solution records. archive.h5 holds models, solution payloads, and source provenance. Solution records distinguish source objectives, evaluated QUBO values, bounds, validation status, and source feasibility. Source LP content is stored only when its blob is at most 1,000,000 bytes; larger sources retain their URL, size, and SHA-256 metadata. The schema is defined by QUBOLib at the release commit. The machine-readable provenance inventory uses metadata schema version 1. Collections, attribution, and modifications Each of the following collections has verified CC BY 4.0 redistribution terms.
